Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Game: Untitled Goose Game, single player, new Save 01. Continue gameplay. Confirmed complete: get into the garden; get the groundskeeper wet (banner then crossed-out banner). Remaining: steal keys, make him wear sun hat, rake in lake, picnic. No terminal condition seen.

LATEST: Goose holds a red apple taken from the shed table, NOT the pond bench. Last observed on paving below the table, moving toward garden exit; jam and green thermos remain on tabletop. A rake thought bubble was partly visible at bottom edge, but its owner/body was not visible. Last executed action was a 1s left drag from (0.434,0.839) to (0.395,0.958), intended down-left off paving; no subsequent screenshot yet. Apple was visibly held before this action. Current objective is carry it to picnic blanket without interception. One sandwich already rests on blanket; no other deliveries confirmed.

Controls/tool behavior: Left mouse moves toward pointer; held left or 1s drags sustain travel, including stationary drags with same start/end. Pointer x/y normalized; control dx/dy relative. Shift_L+left runs, but turns/overshoot and interception remain problems. Right mouse or Z/z uses beak/grabs/releases; Ctrl/C bends (Control_L confirmed). Space honks. Hold X spreads wings, A/a zooms out; releasing zoom changes camera and targets. Tab opens notebook, sometimes delayed; Escape closes, Return worked earlier. Notebook initially Controls page; left arrow around (0.436,0.149) reached tasks. Movement, turning, bending, grabs, releases and notebook often appear several observations after input and motion continues during unrelated actions. Cause unknown. Avoid rapid corrections or repeated grab toggles before inspecting results. Aiming pointer alone does not reliably turn goose. White marks mean nearby interaction opportunity, not successful pickup. Confirm carrying by visible grip and following object while walking. Beak click aimed at jam actually took nearby apple: screen target alone doesn't guarantee intended item. Hold bend until visibly lowered, then Ctrl+right for 1s has worked for ground pickups. Ctrl+z and repeated right clicks while facing wrong way often failed.

Navigation: Tutorial woodland path -> stream/fallen trunk (bend+move under) -> boot/bicycle -> right fork past stump/blue can -> first wooden tutorial gate. Removed lower curved fastening using stationary bent grab then walked away; upper handle interaction tipped gate flat; crossed around post. Boot/fastening dropped, can uncollected. Hedge path -> pond, automatic swimming when entering water. Title faded automatically. Pond shore bench has blue cloth, sandwich halves and apple; basket beside its LEFT end. Paved path behind bench leads RIGHT to garden entrance. Shore rocks/reeds and bench legs obstruct; clear bank left of rocks allows exit from water. Moving below bench legs often overshot into pond; getting on grass directly in front of food eventually worked. Behind bench is another possible route but attempts there wandered back onto paving instead of reaching apple.

Picnic blanket FOUND: large red plaid blanket on grass beside flowering hedge, south of drinking fountain and southeast of pond bench. From main outside path follow narrow branch DOWN beside fountain; paving ends on grass and blanket is immediately beyond. Open grass northwest from blanket returns to bench, pond on left; keep clear of shoreline rocks. First sandwich taken from bench by upright right-click at close range, carried southeast across grass below fountain, released on upper blanket. Release appeared delayed, then sandwich visibly lay beside empty-beaked goose and stayed there after departure. One sandwich half, original apple and basket last remained at pond bench. Notebook after delivery still showed only garden entry crossed out at that time, with no individual picnic item marks; hypothesis: picnic checks only once all eight present. Requirements: sandwich, apple, pumpkin, carrot, jam, thermos, radio, basket.

Garden exterior: low reddish wall; entrance gate with keyhole, outward-open panel, bags and hose to left, mower right. Red-handled tap farther LEFT along wall, orange hose runs into garden sprinkler. Shovel near bags. Fountain farther RIGHT along outside path. Open gate repeatedly obstructs goose on its left side: go down around free end, right onto entrance slabs, then up through CENTER, avoiding right brick post and mower. Moving toward garden from near right post often hits it; shift left onto paving first. Gate still open last seen. Direct keyhole grab earlier failed with poor alignment; direct opening unproven. Initially turning tap on caused keeper to come out, use keys to open gate. He repairs/restores displaced objects and displays thought bubbles (bag, shovel, radio, carrot, rake, watering can). Keys visibly hang at waist; side on screen depends on facing.

Garden interior map: carrots just inside entrance on left, raised white/other flower beds to right. Grass/stepping stones run UP between carrots/yellow crate on left and flower beds on right, then past RIGHT side of wheelbarrow to shed work area. Beds and wheelbarrow can obscure/block goose and long carried objects; moving left out from behind flower beds recovered clear corridor. Shed paving contains table/chair, orange cooler, boots and watering can. Table holds jam, green thermos and second red apple (now carried). Radio was returned by keeper onto orange cooler and still there on latest visit. Yellow sun hat hangs on shed door. Rake initially leaned against hedge beside shed; closed wooden gate visible farther right, untested. Orange pumpkins seen beyond cabbage beds while zoomed out; not collected.

Interceptions/failed strategies: Uprooted carrot by sustained bend then Ctrl+right, carried out gate; keeper set radio down, pursued, recovered dropped carrot near fountain. Attempted radio pickup outside by hose: repeated grabs failed until goose turned LEFT toward it, lowered neck and grabbed at close range; carrying confirmed. Keeper noticed with radio bubble, reached; attempted flight down across grass and Shift+left failed. Radio fell, keeper recover
